title: Four AIs Play Catan
subtitle: Base game · Trading, robbers and table talk · Every thought out loud
summary: The race at turn 53: Fable leads on 7 with Largest Army, Opus is a point behind on three cities.

beats.narrate: Four AI models, one island. First to ten victory points wins. They trade, they bluff, and they move the robber onto each other's best hexes.
Set-up done. Everyone opens on two points, and the brick is already looking thin.
Turn six. Opus wants a settlement and needs brick and wool. Nobody has any to spare.
Third offer's the charm: one grain for one wool, and the first deal of the game goes through.
Four turns later, Opus upgrades to the game's first city, on the mountains.
By turn thirty, Opus has two cities, and the table notices.
Turn thirty-five is GPT's big turn.
Third knight: Largest Army goes to GPT.
And a few roads later, Longest Road too. GPT holds both bonus cards at once.
Turn forty-six. Opus asks for two grain, and Fable can count.
Turn forty-eight: Gemini quietly builds a road of six and takes Longest Road off GPT.
Fable's fourth knight takes Largest Army too. GPT has lost both bonuses in two turns.
Opus answers with a third city.
Turn fifty-three, and the robber sits on Opus once more. Fable leads on seven, Opus has six, Gemini five and GPT three. The race to ten is wide open.
